'''Taneka Shirru''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith Saber]] who was native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. Shirru was part of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] infiltration team that took up residence in the newly-abandoned [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], under orders of [[Grand Lord]] [[Darish Vol]]. She was [[Death|killed]] by an "unknown lifeform" within the lower corridors of the Jedi temple.
